text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Phew...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (The real race is even more intense than I imagined...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(The lingering heat after running through, the blowing wind,
are all so incredibly refreshing—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
From here on, I'm gonna burst out even more...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Man, Bubble Gum Fellow from the "Four Heavenly Kings"—now that was an eye-catching run.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that make you expect big things from the other "Four Heavenly Kings" too?
I'm already getting hyped for the Classic races...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Mmm, as expected of Bubble-chan! I can't let myself fall behind either~!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We tend to be lumped together
as the 'Four Heavenly Kings.'
I can't afford to fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best. Following Bubble's example,
so that we can get off to the best possible start—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done, Bubble.
And then......—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —They really are alike.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I went to greet Bubble Gum Fellow after her debut race—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —How was it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: That was the best debut race ever...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
I had the absolute best time too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
But—
Our dream has only just begun to swell.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's burst open even more from here!
An even greater run... a truly supreme race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bubble Gum Fellow's debut race
concluded without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow and I were holding a meeting
to review her upcoming race rotation.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, there's something I'd like to share
regarding Waltz and the others.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It seems everyone's aiming for the Hopeful Stakes with next year's Classic races in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Hopeful Stakes is a 2000m turf G1 race
held at Nakayama Racecourse at the end of the year."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of the few GⅠ races held during the Junior Class,
and a race that foretells the next year's Classic races—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the "Four Heavenly Kings" seeking to take the racing world by storm,
aiming for the Hopeful Stakes is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, what's important today is—
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to run too, Bubble?
...Do you want to run too, Bubble?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...If it's Bubble Gum Fellow, aiming for the 'Hopeful Stakes' alongside everyone else is well within her reach."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that is what she desires,
then as her Trainer,
I want to respect her wishes.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I'm thinking of quitting.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...To tell the truth, there's another race I really want to run in.
choice_data_list: Is there another race you want to run?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As the vanguard of the 'Four Heavenly Kings,'
I want to achieve results there before anyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS is a 1600m turf GⅠ race
held at Hanshin Racecourse, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like the Hopeful Stakes,
it is one of the G1 races held
during the Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the 2000m Hopeful Stakes,
the 400m shorter distance often turns it
into more of a pure speed contest, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Bubble Gum Fellow's distance aptitudes,
she can fully contend in fast-paced mile races.
The Asahi Hai FS would be a realistic option.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, just as Bubble Gum Fellow said,
the 'Asahi Hai FS' is held
a little earlier than the 'Hopeful S.'"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—I think if I put on a great run in the Asahi Hai FS,
Waltz and the others will definitely think, 'We can do it too!'
choice_data_list: That's such a you-like choice, isn't it?
That's a choice that's very like you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer-san.
You really are quick on the uptake.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I do have another goal in mind, to be fair.
I want to test my distance aptitudes one step further
through this Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"In other words,
I want to find out
'what my strongest distance really is.'"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Surely that will play a part
in our strategy for future races as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Will it be a strategy driven by pure speed,
or a total contest of abilities including stamina?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The outcome of the Asahi Hai FS will likely be
a crucial factor in deciding that policy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, though.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer,
do you think I can be the strongest at 'Mile'
or at 'Medium distance'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As her Trainer, part of me wanted to proudly declare that she could be either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, considering why Bubble Gum Fellow had gone
out of his way to ask, I narrowed my thoughts down
to a single answer—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see! So you figured our chances
were better in the Mile, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer-san, going forward,
I'd like you to consider a rotation
that lets me prove I'm the strongest at that distance.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Having even a glimpse of the goal really gets my fire burning...!
And the harder it is, the better...!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll think it over.
Got it, I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you figured the medium distance
offered better odds, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer-san, going forward,
I'd like you to consider a rotation
that lets me prove I'm the strongest at that distance.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Having even a glimpse of the goal really gets my fire burning...!
And the harder it is, the better...!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll think it over.
Got it, I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And with that, now that we've
sorted everything out—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――I make this declaration.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll run in the Asahi Hai FS, deliver results,
and become the trailblazer of the 'Four Heavenly Kings'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bubble Gum Fellow's next goal became
the Asahi Hai FS...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Early morning, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, it's so quiet and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since I set my sights on the 'Asahi Hai FS,'
my heart's been bursting with excitement...!
At times like this, I just have to run!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Is someone running—
ââHaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (...That sharpness! There's no mistaking it—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ââPhew.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......I'm still nowhere near my ideal.
I must log even more miles—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Heeey, Air Groove~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Bubble, is it?
...Self-training this morning?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Lately, I've been even more hyped than usual.
I'm in the mood to train like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(—Air Groove. Strictly stoic, backed by immense ability,
and a classmate of mine with so much I could learn from.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (And... she and I debuted in the same racing generation. In many ways, our paths are deeply intertwined—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What incredible ambition. Her recent debut race must have been remarkably fruitful.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you can tell?
...Though, you know—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, you're fired up too, Air Groove. More than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —To become the 'ideal' of every Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
With that as my goal, I can no longer
afford to waste a single day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must always strive to be the "ideal" in everyone's eyes,
and never cease to hone myself, even for a fleeting moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...After suffering a defeat in her debut race
and then winning the maiden race the other day,
she reaffirmed her resolve once more."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
There, I intend to deliver a performance
befitting an "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
I understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm planning to run in the Asahi Hai FS too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And so... as the vanguard of the 'Four Heavenly Kings,' I fully intend to deliver results...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh...—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So it seems both you and I
have burdens we intend to bear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And someday, eventually—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Perhaps our paths might cross.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, we will vie for supremacy,
each betting everything we carry on our shoulders."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Right!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why... but I strongly feel that
a time like that will come someday too...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—I'm rooting for you in the Hanshin JF!
And beyond that, too, of course.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll pray for your good fortune in the Asahi Hai FS too. ...And for what lies beyond.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each of their dreams begins to stir.
Gaining heat, little by little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's journey towards
the Asahi Hai FS has only just begun—
